_comment: Semantic part recipe for art/quaternius-ultimate-spaceships/baked/spitfire.obj (Quaternius Ultimate Spaceships, flat-Kd bake). Coordinates are POST scale+yaw (game space: nose -Z, +X starboard; ship bbox x +-2.63, y -1.01..0.51, z -2.20..1.57). Measured on the baked mesh (shell components 2026-08-12): the ship carries FOUR separate engine-pod shells, two stacked per side at x +-(1.87..2.63) - upper pods y -0.31..0.45, lower pods y -1.01..-0.25 - so the x=+-1.85 cut runs through the pod-free gap and only the connecting wing sheet (8 tris) is clipped, and the y=-0.28 split lands in the shells' 0.06 overlap band without touching either hull. Wings span x +-(0.16..2.34) and separate from the fuselage at +-0.52 (the tail block reaches +-0.51; cutting outside it keeps the rear body whole). The nose bulkhead at z=-0.35 keeps the twin under-nose skids (z -0.87..-0.37) entirely in the nose part.
